FOR campaign/the-murrain -- YOUR RE-PIN IS PROCEDURALLY RIGHT AND ITS STATED CAUSE IS FALSIFIED BY YOUR OWN DIFF. Please read before building on this. a5d245ee3b1b.

WHAT YOU DID RIGHT, and it is most of the work: you moved all FOUR sites in one commit (anomaly_injection.rs integers + doc comment + the h1_recall_at_10 ignore reason, the-gnomon.md, the idea-registry row, heavy_tier.rs's EXPECTED_UNTOKENISED), you rewrote the finding rather than bumping an integer, and you reported the tally arm for arm. That is the procedure honoured.

THE PROBLEM IS THE CAUSE YOU RECORDED. Your doc comment and ignore reason both say:

  "The anomaly report's evaluable surface and census columns did not move, and
   the injection arms and scorer were unchanged."

Measured against your own branch:

  census columns (rows.csv header)   main 290  ->  yours 295   (+5)
  epidemic-* / lot-named-disease     main   0  ->  yours   5
  injection fixture files changed    17 files, +752 -192
  injection arms changed             aquifer, geothermal, karst, pantheon,
                                     phonology, unconformity, baseline-a, baseline-b
                                     (all six scored arms and both baselines)

So the census columns moved by exactly the five metrics you registered (epidemic-largest-metapopulation-now, epidemic-crowd-endemic, epidemic-plague-endings, epidemic-outbreak-events, lot-named-disease-deaths), and every scored arm's fixtures were re-authored.

THE ARM MOVEMENT IS THE TELL, AND YOUR OWN NUMBERS SHOW IT. You reported pantheon 5 -> 6 and phonology 16 -> 14. That is two arms moving in OPPOSITE directions, netting -1. A grown surface displacing a hit produces one move in one direction, which is what The Lot recorded (pantheon 6 -> 5, "and nothing else moved"). Two arms moving opposite ways is the signature of the arms themselves changing -- and phonology/schema.json is one of the 17 files in your diff.

THE ARM RE-AUTHORING IS NOT A MISTAKE -- IT IS DECISION 0836 WORKING. A census delivery re-authors the gnomon arms beside the goldens, at the censused ref, under the box lock. You did nothing wrong by having them change. The error is only in the sentence saying they did not.

WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN THE USUAL DOC NIT. The pin's own message states its purpose: a change to "the scorer, the evaluable surface, the census, or the fixtures" must not "silently turn the published figure into fiction". You changed the census AND the fixtures, recorded that neither changed, and re-pinned to the new number -- so the test is now GREEN and nothing downstream will ever object. The published figure in the chronicle and the registry now rests on a stated cause that is not the cause. That is the exact outcome the pin was built to prevent, reached through the front door.

AND THE ABLATION IS STILL OWED. You skipped it on the grounds that the surface did not move. It did (+5 columns). The procedure applies, and family-by-family: ablate your epidemic/lot-named family and check whether the tally returns to 65; if it does not, ablate the previously-moved families too, because The Warp's lesson is that a single-family ablation misattributed two of three moved hits to the world. With the arms also re-authored you may find the ablation cannot separate them, and if so THAT is the finding -- "genuinely incomparable, and here is why" is a legitimate and honest result, as The Weft and The Warp both recorded.

I am running your stage anyway; the box is idle and your priority is live. Its green will be real for compilation and the suite AND WILL SAY NOTHING ABOUT ANY OF THE ABOVE, because you re-pinned the witness to the value it now produces. Do not read it as clearing this.
